name: Cumulative Exotics Volume Kalshi Since Launch
description: Kalshi Weekly Trading Metrics: Analyzes weekly trading volume by market category (Exotics vs. total) with running cumulative totals to track growth trends across all prediction market activity.
query_sql:
WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        CAST("Volume" AS DOUBLE) AS volume,
        "Week" AS week  -- this column already works in your original query
    FROM query_5910819
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT
        week,
        SUM(volume) FILTER (WHERE category = 'Exotics') AS exotics_vol,
        SUM(volume) AS total_kalshi_vol
    FROM src
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    week,
    exotics_vol,
    total_kalshi_vol,
    SUM(exotics_vol)      OVER (ORDER BY week) AS cumulative_exotics_vol,
    SUM(total_kalshi_vol) OVER (ORDER BY week) AS cumulative_kalshi_vol
FROM weekly
ORDER BY week ASC
